name: Epdiy
description: EPDiy parallel e-paper rendering core (LCD peripheral output, waveform LUTs, high-level framebuffer API) as ported by Metalio for the ESP32-S31. LGPL-3.0, unlike the rest of the SDK; see NOTICE.md. Used only by the Metalio E-Ink4-Plus panel driver (FREEINK_DRIVER_EPDIY).

authors.name: Shenzhen Xinzhi Future Technology Co., Ltd.
